results.title: District XI Soccer Playoff Schedule: Schuylkill County Teams, October 26–29
results.description: Schuylkill County boys and girls soccer teams are scheduled for 2026 District XI playoff action from October 26 through October 29, with games at school sites and additional locations yet to be announced. The schedule opens Monday with Tamaqua facing Salisbury in boys Class 2A at 5 p.m. Tuesday includes a home doubleheader at North Schuylkill, with the boys playing Lehighton at 5 p.m. and the girls facing Pleasant Valley at 7 p.m. Schuylkill Haven’s boys travel to Salem Christian on Tuesday, while Pottsville’s boys visit Bangor and the Crimson Tide girls play at Lehighton. Wednesday’s listed games include Tamaqua’s girls against Northwestern Lehigh, Pine Grove’s boys hosting Wilson and Pine Grove’s girls facing Allentown Central Catholic at Salisbury. Thursday’s schedule includes games involving Minersville, Blue Mountain, Schuylkill Haven and Tri-Valley. Several opponents will be determined by earlier playoff results.
